bullets: Led a cross-functional team implementing React (TypeScript) front ends for AEP's field operations platform, integrating 10+ microservice REST APIs and complex data-entry workflows used by thousands of utility technicians nationwide.

Implemented secure authentication and authorization (JWT, role-based access, signed expiring stream URLs); integrated Azure AI Services to summarize and classify field notes; automated Azure DevOps build and release pipelines with Docker agents and test gates in two-week Scrum sprints.
Led engineering for the studio; shipped 0-to-1 React and Next.js products with Node.js and Firebase backends for clients in three countries.

Built a livestreaming product for restaurant and event clients: hls.js / HTML5 video player in React with live HLS playback, quality switching, and live chat over WebSockets, on a Node.js backend handling RTMP ingest to HLS packaging and CDN delivery; responsive Sass/SCSS layouts for mobile and desktop viewers.

Architected a gas delivery tracking platform (300+ daily deliveries) with live driver location and push notifications on Node.js/Express on AWS in Docker; built a wine e-commerce storefront with JWT-secured API integration and an analytics dashboard.
